title: A Recommendation Request
transcript:
Student: Professor Adams, I'm applying to a summer program in Japan. Would you be willing to write me a recommendation?
Professor: I'd be happy to. When's the deadline?
Student: March fifteenth.
Professor: So about three weeks. Could you send me your personal statement and a list of the courses you've taken with me?
Student: Sure. I'm still revising the statement, though.
Professor: Send the draft anyway. It'll help me write something that matches what you're saying.
Student: Okay, I'll email it tonight.

questions.stem: Why does the student visit the professor?
options: To ask for help revising an essay
To get information about studying in Japan
To request a letter of recommendation
To sign up for a summer course
questions.explanation: The student asks the professor to write a recommendation for a summer program.

questions.stem: Why does the professor want to see the draft?
options: So her letter is consistent with the student's application
So she can correct the student's grammar
Because the deadline is earlier than the student thinks
Because she needs it to register the student
questions.explanation: She says the draft will help her write something "that matches what you're saying."
